info.name: SentryPass API
info.description: Every SentryPass endpoint with success and error cases. Run the whole collection top to bottom (Collection Runner or Newman): it creates its own users, exercises the API and deletes them again. Needs the admin account from the seeder. Wait a minute before re-running if you triggered the booking rate limit by hand.

item.name: 1. Setup

exec: pm.test("Returns a token and an admin user", function () { pm.expect(j.token).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(j.user.role).to.eql('admin'); });
pm.test("Registration always creates a customer", function () { pm.expect(j.user.role).to.eql('customer'); });

item.name: 1.8 Customer 3 registers (used for the rate-limit demo)

item.description: Creates the users this run needs. Everything is deleted again in folder 11, so the collection can be re-run.

item.name: 2.2 Register with an email that is taken
2.5 Current user with a valid token

exec: pm.test("Clean JSON, no login redirect", function () { pm.expect(j.message).to.eql('Unauthenticated.'); });

item.name: 2.8 The revoked token no longer works

exec: pm.test("Only organisers returned", function () { j.data.forEach(u => pm.expect(u.role).to.eql('organiser')); });

item.name: 3.5 Customer cannot read someone else's account
3.7 Customer updates their name and tries to promote themselves

exec: pm.test("Name changed, role ignored", function () { pm.expect(j.name).to.eql('Postman Customer One'); pm.expect(j.role).to.eql('customer'); });

item.name: 3.8 Password change needs the current password
3.9 Password change with the right current password
3.10 Admin cannot create a user with an unknown role

exec: pm.test("Owned by the organiser who created it", function () { pm.expect(j.organiser_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('orgA_id')); });

item.name: 5.4 Public list filtered by category and status

exec: pm.test("Only published CTFs", function () { j.data.forEach(e => { pm.expect(e.category).to.eql('ctf'); pm.expect(e.status).to.eql('published'); }); });
pm.test("Exactly organiser A's event", function () { pm.expect(j.total).to.eql(1); });

item.name: 5.7 Event detail includes venue and tiers

exec: pm.test("Consistent error shape", function () { pm.expect(j.message).to.eql('Resource not found.'); });

item.name: 6.1 Another organiser cannot add a tier
6.3 Owner adds the Solo tier (1 seat)
6.4 Owner adds the Pair tier (1 seat)
6.8 Another organiser cannot update a tier
7. Bookings
7.1 Customer 1 books the last Solo seat (confirmed)

exec: pm.test("Confirmed with a signed ticket", function () { pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('confirmed'); pm.expect(j.qr_token).to.have.length(64); });
pm.test("Waitlisted, first in the queue", function () { pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('waitlisted'); pm.expect(j.waitlist_position).to.eql(1); });

item.name: 7.3 Booking the same tier twice is refused

exec: pm.test("Duplicate blocked", function () { pm.expect(j.message).to.include('already have an active booking'); });

item.name: 7.6 Customer lists only their own bookings

exec: pm.test("Own bookings with event details", function () { pm.expect(j.data.length).to.be.at.least(1); j.data.forEach(b => { pm.expect(b.customer.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('c1_id')); pm.expect(b.ticket_type.event.title).to.be.a('string'); }); });

item.name: 7.9 The event's organiser can read it

exec: pm.test("One waitlisted booking on this event", function () { pm.expect(j.total).to.eql(1); });
pm.test("PNG returned from the external API", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('image/png'); });

item.name: 7.13 A waitlisted booking has no QR code yet
7.14 Forged ticket is rejected at check-in

exec: pm.test("Tampering detected", function () { pm.expect(j.message).to.eql('Invalid or tampered ticket.'); });

item.name: 7.17 Check-in with the scanning device's API key
7.18 A ticket cannot be used twice
7.22 The waitlisted customer was promoted automatically

exec: pm.test("Promoted with a fresh signed ticket", function () { pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('confirmed'); pm.expect(j.qr_token).to.have.length(64); });

item.description: Covers the concurrency-safe seat logic, waitlist promotion, signed QR check-in and the device API key.

item.name: 8. Anti-scalping rate limit

exec: pm.test("Attempt 1 is processed (422 validation, still counts)", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(422); });
pm.test("Attempt 2 is processed (422 validation, still counts)", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(422); });
pm.test("Attempt 3 is processed (422 validation, still counts)", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(422); });
pm.test("Attempt 4 is processed (422 validation, still counts)", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(422); });
pm.test("Attempt 5 is processed (422 validation, still counts)", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(422); });

item.name: 8.6 Attempt 6 in the same minute is throttled

exec: pm.test("Anti-scalping limit with Retry-After", function () { pm.expect(j.message).to.include('Too many requests'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Retry-After')).to.exist; });

item.description: POST /bookings allows 5 attempts per minute per user. Uses a customer that is only used here.

exec: pm.test("Fill, check-in and waitlist numbers", function () { pm.expect(j.capacity).to.eql(2); pm.expect(j.fill_rate).to.eql(100); pm.expect(j.attended).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.waitlisted).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.recent_checkins).to.have.length(1); });

item.name: 9.2 Another organiser cannot see the statistics

exec: pm.test("CSV with a header row", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('text/csv'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.match(/^ID,Attendee,Email/); });
pm.test("Draft copy with all seats open", function () { pm.expect(j.title).to.match(/^Copy of /); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('draft'); pm.expect(j.ticket_types).to.have.length(2); });

item.name: 9.6 An event with active bookings cannot be deleted
10.8 A venue that still has events cannot be deleted

exec: pm.test("Guard message", function () { pm.expect(j.message).to.include('still has events'); });

item.name: 11.1 Cancelling the event cancels every active booking

exec: pm.test("Waitlisted and confirmed bookings cancelled", function () { pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('cancelled'); pm.expect(j.cancelled_bookings).to.eql(2); });

item.name: 12. Cleanup
12.4 Admin deletes organiser A (and their event)

item.description: Removes everything created by this run.
